description: PM-5 deployment recorder. No fixture: starts on the real main menu, enters the Plan Editor with recon_stomps + hammer_anvil, lays the army out (one unit by mouse, the rest in bulk), then presses Save as Plan on the banner and saves through the dialog with a real button click. Asserts the pre-filled default name, that the file lands at user://ai_plans/recon_stomps_hammer_anvil.json (deleted first, so its appearance is not a leftover), that the file re-read from disk passes PlanValidator against the live army, that every recorded model position matches the unit actually on the table, and — the claim that matters — that feeding the saved file back to the PM-2a consumer reproduces the deployment from BOTH seats within half an inch, seat 2 through the [44-x, 60-y] mirror, with no unit falling back to the formula.

steps.script:
tree.current_scene._on_formations_confirm_pressed()
return true

tree.current_scene._recreate_unit_visuals()
tree.current_scene._update_deployment_progress()
return true
return node.get_node("/root/Main/PlanSaveDialog/PlanSaveRoot/PlanNameEditRow/PlanNameEdit").text

node.get_node("/root/Main/PlanSaveDialog/PlanSaveRoot/PlanNameEditRow/PlanNameEdit").text = ""
return true
return node.get_node("/root/Main/PlanSaveDialog/PlanSaveRoot/PlanSaveFeedback").text.find("needs a name") >= 0
return FileAccess.file_exists("user://ai_plans/recon_stomps_hammer_anvil.json")

node.get_node("/root/Main/PlanSaveDialog/PlanSaveRoot/PlanNameEditRow/PlanNameEdit").text = "recon_stomps — hammer_anvil"
return true

var d = node.get_node("/root/Main/PlanSaveDialog")
d.get_node("PlanSaveRoot/PlanDescriptionEditRow/PlanDescriptionEdit").text = "Recorded by pm5_record_and_save_plan"
d.get_node("PlanSaveRoot/PlanAuthorEditRow/PlanAuthorEdit").text = "pm5"
return true
return bool(node.get_node("/root/Main/PlanSaveDialog").last_result.get("success", false))
return str(node.get_node("/root/Main/PlanSaveDialog").last_result.get("path", ""))
return FileAccess.file_exists("user://ai_plans/recon_stomps_hammer_anvil.json")
return node.get_node("/root/Main/PlanSaveDialog/PlanSaveRoot/PlanSaveFeedback").text.find("Saved to") >= 0
